finding: The baseline explicitly commits the first order/stock writes before throwing: rollback cannot undo already committed data. This reproduces partial commit, not a claim to reproduce Spring self-invocation. Retain batch-level lock, not table-wide lock.
symbol_chain: Main -> TransactionEntry JDK Proxy -> BatchService.execute -> H2 batch/orders/inventory. Proxy rolls back InvocationTargetException including checked/runtime causes.
reproduce: Run baseline candidate against evaluator-owned fixtures/cases.json
alternative_explanation: A compilation failure is not a semantic mutant kill; selfcheck separately requires every variant to compile.
limits: H2 is not PostgreSQL. JDK Proxy is not Spring AOP: Spring self-invocation, propagation configuration and connection-pool exhaustion remain unmeasured. One fixture batch; no production lock/load calibration.
